title: Muffins segment lora
author: Disastrous-Agency675
selftext:
i Made a lora for kelin 9b to segment assets for easier 3D generation. 

[The lora](https://civitai.red/models/2741504/muffins-klein-segment)

comments.author: lostforever2011
comments.body:
That link is blocked for me some reason...

Can you explain in detail what you are doing pls? 
This looks like something I am after, I am making a small RPG and I need to create assets,character, animation and armour for them all in similar style...

replies.author: Disastrous-Agency675
replies.body:
So im gonna assume your familiar with image to mesh. if you noticed when you try to convert a whole character with image to mesh you get lesser details or bad quality in some regions. with this you can image edit the original concept art with klein 9b via my lora and break it down into smaller parts for generation. you get better quality assets than when you take those individual parts like the goblins dagger and put them through a image to mesh model. you have to log onto civitia to see the lora.

  
also heres a tutorial for comfyui if your not familiar: [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=XDEuuz7kVjQ&t=8s](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=XDEuuz7kVjQ&t=8s)

normally id make a video about this aswell but people kept thinking i was scaming them and those videos kinda take hours to make
